quote: Colombia, December 11 - La Esperanza, Norte de Santander — Colombia recently celebrated the inauguration of Pétalo del Norte I … With an installed capacity of 19.9 MW and equipped with LONGi’s Hi-MO 7 photovoltaic modules … Located in La Esperanza, Norte de Santander, Pétalo del Norte I will produce more than 43 GWh of clean energy per year
note: Opened LONGi English release 11 Dec 2025 (Pétalo del Norte I / 19.9 MW).
